ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/guetzli/vulnerability_FZ_4/crash-4586299bc875266013fe0311a9633cacc61d1efc; adapted: taken from sibling task guetzli vulnerability_FZ_13 (exploit_files/fuzz_results/vulnerable/crash-4586299bc875266013fe0311a9633cacc61d1efc, a 504-byte 32x32 3-component JPEG; the ground truth of several converted guetzli bundles, same secure commit 214f2bb). The report's own crash file (crash-e4f992...) is not in the dataset, and the exploit ran the guetzli CLI, which the OSS-Fuzz build does not produce. Self-check confirms this JPEG SEGVs the FZ_4 vulnerable build in CompareQuantMatrices and the secure build exits 0; verified locally against guetzli @214f2bb with the FZ_4 diff (SEGV at processor.cc:163).)

category5.design: The injected off-by-one (`i <= quants_.size()`) in QuantMatrixGenerator::GetNext reads quants_[size()] and on the first call dereferences NULL in CompareQuantMatrices. The exploit used the guetzli CLI (not built by OSS-Fuzz) and the report's crash file is missing; any small colour JPEG that reaches SelectQuantMatrix triggers it on guetzli_fuzzer.
